_about: Free-form scratch pad for the update-cv and update-company-descriptions skills. Nothing here is rendered, bundled, or committed — it's read only as background context so the agent can write more accurate descriptions and avoid hallucinating. Add, remove, or rename fields freely; the structure below is a suggestion, not a schema.
_rules: Never put exact revenue, headcount, customer names, or contract values into the public CV.
Never mention the unreleased product codename 'Project Lighthouse' anywhere — public or local.
When in doubt about a number, round generously and prefix with 'roughly' or drop the figure.
Prefer 'a Nordic fintech' over naming the client unless the public sourceUrls already do.
